To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
long duration spaceflight induces a stress related release of endocannaboids that is associated with an aberrant activation of the immune system.
long duration spaceflight triggered an aberrant immune response with a shift toward inflammation that lasted even after return to Earth.
long-term spaceflight induces a stress response that is associated with immune activation, a reduction in regulatory T cells and an increase of CD8+ memory T cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of long duration space flights on the immune system.
the effects of the spaceflight environment on the immune system and the underlying mechanism for the observed changes.
the impact of space travel on human physiology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the immune system is affected by spaceflight and that this effect is not only limited to short duration spaceflight.
long-term spaceflight induces an immune activation that is accompanied by an increased release of endocanabinoids.
spaceflight is a stressor that induces a stress response in humans that may lead to a shift toward inflammaging.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the immune system of cosmonauts was shifted towards an inflammation-like state during long-term spaceflight.
long-term spaceflight induces an inflammatory response, which is characterized by a shift in the immune system towards a pro-inflammatory state and is accompanied by a stress response.
long-term spaceflight triggers stress-related changes in the immune system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the immune system is highly sensitive to space flight.
the immune system of long-duration spaceflight participants is highly activated in-flight.

long-term spaceflight induces an aberrant immune response in cosmonauts that persists after return to Earth and that this immune activation is accompanied by an increase in stress related markers such as endocannabinoid levels.
